title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: US Treasury secretary emerges as frontrunner for Trump’s AI czar role: Report
summary: US President Donald Trump previously tapped David Sacks as his AI and crypto czar before Sacks stepped down from the role earlier this year after reaching his service limit as a special government employee.

title: Malicious iOS app FomoPeek linked to $580K crypto theft, SlowMist says
summary: SlowMist said malicious FomoPeek versions distributed through Apple’s App Store used iOS kernel exploits to escape the sandbox and access sensitive data from other apps.

title: AI potential to drive crypto demand remains ‘underappreciated’: BlackRock
summary: BlackRock says AI agents could drive demand for stablecoins and programmable payment rails, while tokenized computing capacity could create another opportunity for digital assets.

title: OpenAI, Anthropic to brief UN Security Council on AI risks: Reports
summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are expected to brief the UN Security Council as it examines AI risks and global security.

title: CFTC issues warning over risky prediction market ‘mention’ contracts
summary: The warning comes weeks after the CFTC fined a former White House teleprompter operator who made more than $107,000 trading prediction contracts tied to President Trump’s speeches.

title: Arch Lending eyes tokenized stocks as next collateral market
summary: Arch Lending’s Himanshu Sahay said on Cointelegraph’s Chain Reaction podcast that the lender plans to move into tokenized equities as onchain stocks gain traction as collateral.

title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
summary: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.

title: Canada’s six largest banks explore tokenized Canadian dollar deposits
summary: The country’s largest financial institutions are exploring tokenized deposits for interbank payments, just weeks after regulators clarified how they should be treated.

title: Zcash gets first European ETP following US ETF launch
summary: 21shares listed physically backed ZEC and ETHFI products on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam, as issuers broaden their offerings beyond major cryptocurrencies.
